common:
Create a premium HAVENLINE game-resource 360-degree concept turnaround sheet, matching the supplied Havenline art boards precisely in visual language: polished stylized 3D, chunky rounded forms, broad sculpted details, warm caramel wood, restrained cool-metal highlights, readable game silhouettes, handcrafted inviting winter-survival aesthetic. The reference images are STYLE references, not edit targets. Do not copy their buildings, layout, UI or tiny text.
Landscape high-resolution sheet, ideally 3072x2048. Uniform dark navy studio background. Elegant clear small heading at top and eight equally sized view panels arranged exactly FOUR columns by TWO rows. Same SINGLE asset rotated in place about the vertical axis, same physical geometry and color/material pattern in EVERY panel. Camera elevation 15 degrees above horizontal, orthographic-like product rendering. Consistent subject scale, fixed soft neutral studio light, generous margins, fully visible objects. Exact clockwise yaw order: top row FRONT 0°, FRONT RIGHT 45°, RIGHT 90°, REAR RIGHT 135°; bottom row REAR 180°, REAR LEFT 225°, LEFT 270°, FRONT LEFT 315°. Front and rear must be genuinely opposite surfaces; right and left are true narrow end/profile views, not repeated three-quarter views. Make stable distinctive landmarks and physically coherent occlusions. Each view gets only its exact readable name below. No perspective diagram arrows, no environment, no ground tile, no props, no anatomy, no hands, no logos/watermarks. Small footer reads "360° CONCEPT TURNAROUND".

specs.title: STEEL
specs.body: One refined solid steel ingot pickup, rounded rectangular bar with sloped truncated-trapezoid sides. Long horizontal X axis, proportions2.0 long x0.8 deep x0.5 tall. Broad smooth cool blue-gray metal faces, clean large soft silver rim highlights, satin finish, no mirror chrome, no rust. One simple shallow rectangular inset centered in the top face, no writing; no other decoration. Subtly asymmetrical tiny chamfer notch at only FRONT-RIGHT upper edge, fixed through the views. No strap, stack, support pallet or snow. FRONT/REAR show broad long faces, RIGHT/LEFT narrow end faces. The FRONT RIGHT view reveals right end on image right; REAR RIGHT reveals the right end on image LEFT; REAR LEFT reveals the opposite left end on image RIGHT; FRONT LEFT reveals left end on image left. Make the two rear diagonals genuinely opposite, not duplicates.

specs.title: METAL ORE
specs.body: One raw mineable iron-ore chunk pickup, an irregular chunky dark charcoal stone with FOUR broad embedded silvery-gray metallic nodules and a small rusty ochre mineral patch on one side. No fantasy colored crystals, glowing elements, gems or vivid orange/blue crystals. Compact beveled asymmetrical boulder,1.25wide x0.85deep x0.75high. Largest silver nodule on FRONT upper-left face, smaller pair on RIGHT side, single low nodule on REAR face; ochre patch on LEFT. Continuous stone mass, no loose pieces, no base, no snow. The landmarks occupy fixed3D positions and occlude naturally through all8views. Clearly darker and more metallic than ordinary stone, not a refined steel bar. The two rear diagonals have opposite handedness, never duplicate an angle.

specs.title: FUEL
specs.body: One compact portable fuel canister pickup. Chunky industrial painted muted orange-red jerrycan with gently rounded corners and a simple integrated carry handle at top. Proportions0.9wide x0.42deep x1.25high. A single dark steel screw cap offset toward object's RIGHT upper shoulder; handle centered. Wide front face has one embossed X reinforcement and small plain cream rectangle near bottom with a minimal dark droplet symbol; wide rear face has embossed X only, no label. Side walls narrow with one vertical seam, stable metal bottom rim. Clean broad painted material with very restrained edge wear, no texture noise, no text on can, no symbols besides droplet. No hose, pallet, snow, second handle or accessories. FRONT/REAR are widefaces, RIGHT/LEFT true narrow profiles. At RIGHT90 the cap is closest; at LEFT270 cap lies beyond handle. REAR RIGHT135 and REAR LEFT225 must expose different narrow sides and opposite handedness, no repeated threequarter. The cream label is visible only from FRONT/FRONTRIGHT/FRONTLEFT, completely absent from rear hemisphere.
